# TRIGRAMS Studio

> TRIGRAMS Studio builds the landing page, photo and video so you can start putting your business in front of customers, lean and quick. It is run by Alex Oliver at 130 Burswood Rd, Burswood WA 6100 (Perth, Western Australia), open 10am to 3pm, Monday to Friday. It makes 3 things for small businesses: a landing page (from $1,500 plus GST, usually live in 2 to 3 weeks, hosting $25 a month), photos, and short videos. Photos and video are priced on a call. It also makes and runs Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns, from $4,000 plus GST, at https://ads.trigrams.studio. To start, answer a few questions and book a call at https://www.trigrams.studio/book-a-call, or email hello@trigrams.studio. ABN 85 714 298 118.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.trigrams.studio/): what you get, how it works, and common questions
- [Work](https://www.trigrams.studio/work): landing pages, videos and photos made for Perth small businesses
- [Book a call](https://www.trigrams.studio/book-a-call): a few questions, then a calendar to book a 30 minute call
- [Enquire](https://www.trigrams.studio/enquiry): the written enquiry form
- [Join the team](https://www.trigrams.studio/join): applications to work at TRIGRAMS Studio

## Other TRIGRAMS sites

- [Meta ads](https://ads.trigrams.studio): the Facebook and Instagram ad campaign offer, from $4,000 plus GST
